deep convolutional neural networks trained on a large dataset of multimodal medical images can achieve high classification accuracy and can also be used for retrieval of medical images.
deep convolutional neural networks are capable of learning high level semantic information that can be used to retrieve medical image databases.
deep learning based CBMIR systems can achieve better retrieval results than conventional CBMIR systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a deep learning based CBMIR framework that is able to learn features from a large number of images and is capable of classifying images into a predefined set of classes.
the development of deep learning based medical image retrieval framework that can help clinicians to retrieve medical images efficiently.
the development of a CBMIR system that uses deep CNN for classification and retrieval of multimodal images.

the proposed framework of deep learning is able to achieve high classification accuracy and retrieval precision for CBMIR systems.
the proposed method is best to retrieve multimodal images for different body parts and organs.
deep learning has a great promise for medical image retrieval.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
deep convolutional neural networks are a powerful tool for CBMIR systems.
the proposed deep learning framework is a promising approach for CBMIR and can be further improved by using different deep learning techniques.
the proposed framework is able to learn features that are able to characterize the high level semantic information and is able to retrieve the medical images based on their semantic content.

deep learning based feature extraction can be used to retrieve medical image efficiently.
the deep learning framework can learn features that can be used to classify medical images and retrieve images with high accuracy.
